corrections: Mesh packing uses the original float constant 255.99000549316406 at VA 0xA067F0, truncates with CVTTSS2SI and retains each low byte; do not substitute clamped conversion or multiplication by 255.
The native routine also handles null visual entries and non-mesh visuals, including conditional colour writes and dirty-bit updates. The mesh-only description is incomplete.
Graphics updateItemColour token is 0x06001179; setTogglebarVars is 0x0600117D. The nine-byte forwarding body is also shared by gaControlsOptions.updateItemColour.
The note's Wine regression and mod tests were not rerun. Original replacement stores support the shading explanation, but do not independently establish the reported live UI outcome.

findings.hint: Recover the complete 418-byte leaf member as x86 thiscall: ECX is item, one stack argument points to four floats, callee returns with RET 4. Copy RGBA to item +0x54..0x60, traverse 20-byte visual entries through item +0x184/+0x188, and preserve both mesh and non-mesh branches.
evidence: Original executable SHA-256 and the 418-byte fragment hash exactly agree with the note's supplied hashes.
Disassembly establishes entry 0x448500, all branches converging on the epilogue ending at 0x4486A1, INT3 padding, and a separate routine beginning at 0x4486B0.
0x448542 loads the visual pointer from each entry; null pointers skip processing. 0x44854C tests visual +0x12C.
Mesh vector begin/end are visual +0x120/+0x124. Signed division by 36 determines iteration count; 0x4485E6 stores packed replacement colour at vertex +8 without reading its old colour.
Packing shifts the low bytes of truncated scaled R, G, B and A into numeric 0xRRGGBBAA.
0x44860F–0x448658 compares non-mesh RGBA at +0x90..0x9C using UCOMISS/LAHF parity logic. Unequal or unordered values trigger four writes and OR 0x100 into visual +0x170.
Original .rdata contains pointer 0x448500 at VA 0x9F9C54; adjacent routine 0x4486B0 dispatches through vtable +0x10.
Searches found no corresponding entry in native_blocks.hpp or the searched recovered source and coverage records.
dependencies: 32-bit item, visual-entry and vertex layouts; valid begin/end pointers.
SSE conversion and comparison behavior, including MXCSR state.
No calls or imports occur inside the inspected routine.
validation_plan: Execute the original entry through a C/C++ x86 ABI harness and compare complete fixture memory against a candidate implementation.
Cover empty visual ranges, null entries, mixed visual types, empty meshes and multiple vertices with distinct initial colours.
Test equal and changed non-mesh colours, signed zero and NaNs; verify dirty-bit preservation and untouched memory.
Test fractional, negative and out-of-range components against original low-byte conversion behavior under a recorded MXCSR state.
Check callee-saved registers, stack cleanup and guard regions.
limits: No execution harness was run during this review.
The semantic name and slot identity are consistent with the note and inspected dispatch/data, but the full constructor-to-vtable identity chain was not reconstructed.
Aliasing and malformed vector behavior require original execution before claiming comprehensive equivalence.

findings.hint: Recover the complete 273-byte IL body as a small positioning helper, preserving call order and explicit floating-point conversion points. Its behavior is already described in RERIFF-EVIDENCE.md, but no corresponding recovered implementation was found.
evidence: Method row 4477 establishes token 0x0600117D. Actual IL spans IL_0000 through RET at IL_0110, with maxstack four.
Menu byte +305 selects sprite 75 when zero and 74 otherwise; thumb pointer is menu +252. Calls setSpriteDef at IL_001E, then setOrigin at IL_003F with origin 3 or 5.
Bar pointer is menu +248; position comes from bar +0x20/+0x24 and width from +0x30. Scale is menu +0x3C.
The zero-state branch subtracts rounded width-times-scale from X. State then selects +25 or -25 times scale before vector addition and setPos at IL_010B.
The complete body contains no explicit colour-reset call.
Existing RERIFF-EVIDENCE.md already records this token and its positioning behavior.

review.summary: Approved as assembly-reference evidence for VA 0x448500–0x4486A1, with zero source credit. The complete 418-byte span includes the mesh and non-mesh paths omitted from the research note’s mesh-only description. Mesh conversion uses the original 255.99000549316406 constant and truncated low bytes; non-mesh visuals have conditional colour and dirty-bit updates. Behavior tests, source equivalence, the full vtable identity chain, malformed or aliased ranges, exception behavior, and the reported live UI outcome remain unverified.
review.reason: Independently assembled and linked the symbolic candidate at its original VA and compared all 418 bytes against Game.exe; they match without masking. Disassembly confirms the entry, internal branches, preserved registers, ret 4, subsequent padding and next entry at 0x4486B0. The original executable hash, external float constant, dispatch-table pointer and direct caller also agree with the candidate’s stated evidence.
